text:
toni: quick note — hit a reproducible semantic skew on canary while onboarding redwood-magnet-13b-q2_k with stacked prefill windows. seems tied to KV fingerprint churn when two sessions finish near-simultaneously.
rahul: repro steps?
toni: short repro: spawn two staggered clients with overlapping priming (prefill sizes 4096/4096 overlap=512) and stream a long doc (~9k tokens). script: 
```
python tools/repro_overlap.py --model magnet-13b-q2_k --clients 2 --prefill 4096 --overlap 512 --max-tokens 9000
```
rahul: logs?
toni: trimmed runtime excerpt: 
```
[2026-07-02T08:11:02Z] session=A prefill_done base=0 len=4096 kv_fp=0x7a3d21
[2026-07-02T08:11:03Z] session=B prefill_done base=3584 len=4096 kv_fp=0x7a3d1e
[2026-07-02T08:11:03Z] WARN kv_fp_collision detected delta=-3
[2026-07-02T08:11:03Z] ERROR rotary_phase_alias layer=9 delta=3
```
kai: delta -3 on fingerprint suggests remap arithmetic flipped sign somehow. is this only on q2_k?
toni: yes. float32 and q8_0 are clean. q2_k and q3_b show the issue but q2_k more frequent.
rahul: can you run with runtime::prefill_serialized=true to rule out transport ordering?
toni: tried that — serialized prefill removes the flake entirely. so concurrency window is required.
kai: good. next step: capture per-client KV fingerprint sequence and the prefill completion nanosecond timestamp. also dump per-layer rotary cos/sin norms at token_pos ~7200.
toni: added small probe: 
```
python -c "from runtime import dump_kv_fp, dump_rot_norms; dump_kv_fp(); dump_rot_norms(token_pos=7200)"
```
ml-bot: @toni job 4971230000-overlap-repro started on worker-canary-3 :white_check_mark:
rahul: if serialized prefill fixes it, sounds like a race updating the global KV slot allocator. CAS might help. but since quant amplifies it, could be rounding producing off-by-few when two writes interleave.
kai: agree. proposal: 1) add CAS to allocator 2) when CAS fails, recompute remap in FP and compare against quantized remap; if mismatch > 2 tokens, increment a metric and optionally fallback that request to FP rotary for offending layers.
toni: implemented a micro-probe that detects allocator contention and logs the pre/post remap values. pushing traces to /staging/traces/4971230000/.
rahul: also try integer-accumulation for the rotary multiply for q2_k as an experiment — less rounding drift in chain multiply.
kai: one more: add a unit test that simulates two prefill completions in the same timeslice and verifies monotonic remap. put it behind a flaky-only CI tag.
toni: will open PR with failing test + trace. tagging @eng-ml and @eng-runtime.
infra-bot: @rahul created ticket INF-2026: KV-slot-allocator-race (priority=P2) :white_check_mark:
rahul: thanks. if we confirm this is the root cause we should gate q2_k on Dedicated until we have mitigation (fallback or fix).
kai: agreed. low-latency fallback to FP rotary for layers where fingerprint mismatch detected seems pragmatic.
toni: ongoing — will update here when I have deterministic two-client single-threaded interleaved repro. :mag:
